winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架

让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

subtitles.zh: 但显然，地方政府财政状况很弱，商业银行和经济也疲软，对吧？
subtitles.en: But obviously, local governments, they were very weak in their physical situation, commercial banks, the economy is weak, right?

subtitles.zh: 所以信贷需求非常疲软。这一次，你可以看到央行和中央政府投入了大量、更多的资源来支持经济。
subtitles.en: So in their face and very weak demand for credit. So this time around, you can see the central bank and central governments are putting a lot of, a lot more resources into supporting the economy.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为新的动能将来源于此。这是直接的国家推动。
subtitles.en: So I guess this is where the new momentum will come from. This is a direct state push.

subtitles.zh: 你知道，我认为今年早些时候的策略一直是，我要卖出中国、买入韩国。
subtitles.en: And you know, I think the strategy I think earlier this year was always, I'm going to sell China by Korea.

subtitles.zh: 你认为这个交易现在在某些方面正在逆转吗？
subtitles.en: Is that trade you think reversing now in some ways?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我不想对抗AI，对吧？所以你之前谈到的所有故事、数字、报告，它们仍然相当强劲。

subtitles.en: But on top of that, obviously Taiwan, Korea, their stocks have gone through the roof. And China has really, and performed significantly.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，至少从战术角度来看，高歌猛进的台湾和韩国市场可能会暂停一下。
subtitles.en: So I think from, at least from a tactical point of view, the high-flying Taiwanese and the Korean market will likely take a pause.

subtitles.zh: 然后新兴市场中深度受压的部分，比如中国、巴西，未来会表现更好。
subtitles.en: And then the deeply depressed parts of EM, like China, Brazil, for example, they will do better going forward.

subtitles.zh: 所以这是一个小型轮动的故事。好的。

subtitles.zh: 那么在轮动方面，你在中国权益市场中关注和倾向哪些方向？
subtitles.en: So in terms of rotation, what are you looking and tilting towards to in the China equity market?

subtitles.zh: 如果你现在在第四季度增持，什么可能推动这个市场到年底？
subtitles.en: Then if you're going overweight now in the fourth quarter, what could potentially be driving this market into the end of the year?

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们之前看到的，尤其是今年第二季度，可能特别是在那之后，我们可以看到中国政府确实有意放缓了基础设施的资本支出，因为我们在第一季度有积极的惊喜。
subtitles.en: I think what we saw earlier, especially in the second quarter of this year, probably especially after the run-war, we can see the Chinese government really intentionally slowed down capital spending in infrastructure because we had positive

subtitles.zh: 然后可能北京担心，如果他们真的增加基础设施支出，会进一步推高企业的成本压力。
subtitles.en: And then probably Beijing was concerned that if they really increased spending in infrastructure, they would further push up cost pressure for companies.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，在第四季度，我预计一些资本密集型板块会表现更好，尤其是它们来自如此低迷的起点。
subtitles.en: So I think like, so in Q4, I would expect some kind of capital intensive sectors to do better, especially they are coming from such a depressed starting point.

subtitles.zh: 但也有一些其他消费板块、医疗板块，几年前它们的估值倍数非常高。现在它们已经被完全洗出去了。
subtitles.en: But also some other consumer sectors, consumer sectors, healthcare sectors, they were treating at very high multiples a few years ago. Now they have been completely washed out.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为总体而言，我们预计市场将广泛上涨，但一些结构性故事，如消费板块、医疗板块可能表现良好。
subtitles.en: So I think broadly speaking, we would expect a broad rally in the stock market, but some structure stories like consumer sector, healthcare sector were likely to do well.

subtitles.zh: 还有一些资本密集型板块，材料、大宗商品相关板块也可能表现良好。
subtitles.en: And some very kept intensive sectors, material, commodity-related sectors were also probably to well.

subtitles.zh: 那么新兴市场金融板块的上涨潜力如何？
subtitles.en: What about the potential for upside for financials out of EMs?

briefs.speaker: Yang Wang
briefs.speaker_context: Chief EM and China Strategist at Alpine Macro
briefs.current_title: Alpine Macro王岩：新兴市场金融板块迎来配置窗口？
current_title_lines: 货币政策周期带来顺风？

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，这可能有点不同，但我们看到上周过去几个交易日，尤其是在香港市场，金融板块受到严重打击，因为一些关于收益率上升和金融状况的担忧。
subtitles.en: I mean, maybe a bit of a separate story, but we have been seeing the past couple of sessions last week, especially on the hung saying the finance stocks getting hard hit because of some of these elevated yield financial condition concerns.

subtitles.zh: 总体而言，如果我们谈论新兴市场金融板块，历史上新兴市场金融板块的相对表现与新兴市场的货币周期有非常紧密的相关性。
subtitles.en: Broadly speaking, if we talk about EM, EM financial, the relative performance of EM financials historically has had a very tight correlation with the monetary cycle in EM.

subtitles.zh: 所以这实际上相当讽刺，如果央行在边际上收紧，这对银行来说是好消息，因为这支持了它们的利润率，它们的净息差。
subtitles.en: So this is actually quite ironic if central banks are tightening that on margin, it's good news for banks because that supports their profit margin, their net interest margin.

subtitles.zh: 所以以企业借款人、企业家庭借款人为代价，实际上在紧缩周期中，金融板块往往表现更好。
subtitles.en: So at the expense of corporate borrowers, corporate household borrowers, so actually one in the tightening cycle, financials tend to do better.

subtitles.zh: 所以实际上在这一点上，我们认为增加对新兴市场金融板块的敞口是有道理的，因为现在边际上，新兴市场的银行正朝着紧缩周期移动。
subtitles.en: So at this point actually, we think it makes sense to increase exposure to EM financials because now on margin, EMs under banks are moving towards a tightening cycle.

subtitles.zh: 随着时间的推移，这可能为新兴市场金融板块带来某种顺风。
subtitles.en: And over time, this could lead to some kind of tailwind for EM financials.

1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.

briefs.speaker: Yang Wang
briefs.speaker_context: Chief EM and China Strategist at Alpine Macro
briefs.current_title: Alpine Macro王岩：全球收益率上行，风险资产如何应对？
current_title_lines: 风险资产需要重新定价？

subtitles.zh: 我只是想知道，全球收益率上升，王岩，你怎么看？我认为，当我们认为5%可能是风险资产脱轨的水平时。
subtitles.en: I'm just wondering what the rising global yields, Yang Wang, how you feel about it, right? I thought, when we thought 5% was where this could derail risk assets in the light.

subtitles.zh: 我们还没有完全看到这一点。我们是否需要在美国经济开始放缓时，认为中性利率会更高？
subtitles.en: We haven't quite seen that just yet. Do we need to subscribe a higher neutral rate on when the U.S. economy starts to slow down?

subtitles.zh: 你认为什么会支撑这一点？例如，是否需要美联储加息，或者你认为整个AI资本支出热潮的自然放缓会减缓事情？
subtitles.en: And what do you think is going to backstop that? Does it need a fed rate hike, for example, or do you think it's going to be a natural slowdown in this whole AI cap ex boom that's going to slow things down?

subtitles.zh: 我想它必须，你知道，市场必须见顶。它至少需要债券市场抛售来修正。
subtitles.en: I guess it has to, you know, the market has to peak out. It has the least correct for the bond market to sell off.

subtitles.zh: 但现在如果市场继续上涨，那么你知道，这意味着金融条件和利率还没有真正过度限制。
subtitles.en: But now if the stock market just keeps doing, keeps rising, then, you know, it means that the financial conditions interest rates are not really overly restrictive yet.

subtitles.zh: 那么债券收益率可能会继续上升。你知道，显然，从配置的角度来看，现在债券收益率处于这个水平，显然从配置角度来看变得更有吸引力。
subtitles.en: So then the bond yields will probably stay community to rise. You know, obviously, from from allocation point of view, now bond yields are at this level, obviously, it becomes a lot more attractive from allocation point of view.

subtitles.zh: 但我想，市场必须真正感受到收益率上升的压力，收益率才会回落。好的。
subtitles.en: But I guess it really, you know, stock market has to really feel the pressure from rising yield for yields to come off. All right.

briefs.speaker: Kate Zhang
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of MS Capital, a China-focused quantitative hedge fund
briefs.current_title: MS Capital张凯：内地市场波动中，量化策略如何捕捉超额收益？

subtitles.zh: 我们今年表现相当不错，年初至今大约22%。
subtitles.en: We are doing actually pretty good this year, the year-to-date is around 22%.

subtitles.zh: 因为我认为内地市场庞大、深厚且流动性充足。
subtitles.en: Because I think China market is enormous and also deep and liquid.

subtitles.zh: 所以差异创造了离散度，而离散度对我们这样的量化投资者来说创造了超额收益机会。
subtitles.en: So the difference is creates dispersion and dispersion for our like quantum investors creates opportunities of alpha.

subtitles.zh: 你们今年涨了多少？22%。
subtitles.en: You guys are up, how much this year? 22%.

subtitles.zh: 那市场中性策略呢？市场中性策略。为什么选择市场中性？
subtitles.en: So what about market neutral strategy? Market neutral strategy. Why market neutral?

subtitles.zh: 我认为内地市场是获取超额收益的好市场，而市场中性是为了对冲大部分市场方向。
subtitles.en: I see China is a very good market for alpha and the market neutral is to hedge most of the direction of the market.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们不需要预测方向。
subtitles.en: So we don't need to predict the direction.

subtitles.zh: 我们只需要稳定的离散度。
subtitles.en: We just have a steady dispersion.

briefs.speaker: Kate Zhang
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of MS Capital, a China-focused quantitative hedge fund
briefs.current_title: MS Capital张凯：监管收紧是清洗噪音，还市场健康环境

subtitles.zh: 7月有一些回撤，对吧？当时证监会开了很多会议，讨论AI和量化交易的使用等，MS Capital在这方面表现如何？
subtitles.en: July, there was a bit of a drawdown, right? There was all this CSRC had a lot of meetings talking about the usage of AI and quant trading and the like, how has MS Capital fared in that?

subtitles.zh: 你们现在如何应对这些动态？是的。
subtitles.en: How are you working with these dynamics right now? Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我认为监管收紧政策实际上是在做有利的事。
subtitles.en: I think the regulatory, the tightening of the policy is actually doing less favor.

subtitles.zh: 他们试图清洗不良行为，去除市场中的噪音。
subtitles.en: They are trying to wash out the bad behaviors and remove the noise from the market.

subtitles.zh: 从而给我们留下一个干净健康的环境。
subtitles.en: So leave us a clean and healthy playground.

subtitles.zh: Kate，你谈到市场中的一些噪音。
subtitles.en: Kate, you talk about some of the noise in the markets.

briefs.speaker: Kate Zhang
briefs.speaker_context: CEO of MS Capital, a China-focused quantitative hedge fund
briefs.current_title: MS Capital张凯：AI如何增强量化策略与风控？

subtitles.zh: 这相当了不起，因为据我们了解，在快速变动的市场中，你们的模型能够捕捉到一些变化。
subtitles.en: I mean, it's quite remarkable because as we understand it, fast-moving markets, your models have been able to pick up some of these shifts.

subtitles.zh: 你能详细介绍一下它们是如何构建来实现这一点的吗？是的。
subtitles.en: Can you walk us through how exactly they're being structured to be able to do this? Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们有一个非常严谨的策略制定流程。
subtitles.en: I think we have a very disciplined process of making the strategy.

subtitles.zh: 我们首先处理数据，然后识别模式。
subtitles.en: We first, we process the data and then we identify the pattern.

subtitles.zh: 然后我们有严格的风险控制管理。
subtitles.en: Then we have a vigorous risk control management.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为整个过程也由AI增强。
subtitles.en: So I think the whole process is also enhanced by AI.

subtitles.zh: 现在我们甚至开发了自己的LLN来读取和解读这些信号，形成我们自己的模式。
subtitles.en: Now we even developed our own LLN to read and interpret this signal into our own pattern.

subtitles.zh: 然后我们根据市场状态调整所有这些因子和策略。
subtitles.en: And then we adapted all these factors, all these strategies due to the market regime.

subtitles.zh: AI在风险评估方面具体如何帮助？你谈到这些LLM。
subtitles.en: And how exactly is AI helping with the risk assessment side of the process? You talk about these LLMs.

events.candidate_system_prompt:
You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.

- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.

briefs.speaker_context: CEO of MS Capital, a China-focused quantitative hedge fund
briefs.current_title: MS Capital张凯：超额收益不会消失，但懒人收益将退场

subtitles.zh: 它们正在开发中。是的。
subtitles.en: They're being developed. Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我认为AI确实让量化策略和量化交易更强大。
subtitles.en: I think AI does make quant strategies, quant trading is more powerful.

subtitles.zh: 因为AI本身不是超额收益，而是一种工具。
subtitles.en: As AI itself isn't an alpha, but it's a tool.

subtitles.zh: 取决于你如何使用它。
subtitles.en: It depends on how you use it.

subtitles.zh: 例如，我们早在2015年就将AI应用于我们的研究平台。
subtitles.en: For example, we, I think we applied AI to our research platform quite early back to 2015.

subtitles.zh: 如今我们确实看到了成果带来的好处。是的。
subtitles.en: And we do see the benefits from the result these days. Yeah.

subtitles.zh: 你怎么看，似乎有点矛盾，对吧？
subtitles.en: I mean, how do you look at the, there seems to be a bit of paradox, right?

subtitles.zh: 因为你看一些内地上市公司的分析师覆盖情况，
subtitles.en: Because you look at how what analyst coverage is on some of these A share listed companies,

subtitles.zh: 尤其是小盘股，我认为现在已经下降到略低于40%。
subtitles.en: particularly when it comes to small caps, I think that's dwindled to just under 40% here right now.

subtitles.zh: 但你看这些买卖价差，它们相当紧，比大多数新兴市场都要紧。
subtitles.en: But when you look at these bid-ass spreads, they're quite tight and quite tighter than most emerging markets out there here right now.

subtitles.zh: 你如何应对？在某种程度上，你认为这是看待量化交易和量化策略的矛盾吗？是的。
subtitles.en: How do you deal with that? And in some ways, do you think that it's a paradox in how you look at quant trading and quant strategies now? Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我认为现在人们总是问，随着市场变得拥挤，超额收益是否还存在，存在超额收益压缩。是的，仍然有超额收益，但懒惰的、容易的超额收益将退场。
subtitles.en: I think now people always ask, is there still alpha as it's getting crowded, there's alpha squeeze. Yes, there's still alpha, but the lazy alpha, the easy alpha is going to be retired.

subtitles.zh: 这取决于你在哪里寻找以及如何定义超额收益。
subtitles.en: And it depends on where you look for it and how you define the alpha.

subtitles.zh: 由于新政策、新环境，总会有新的超额收益。
subtitles.en: There's also always a new alpha because of the new policy, new environment.

subtitles.zh: 你不能依赖单一因子、单一策略、单一模型。
subtitles.en: And you cannot rely on one factor, one strategy, one model.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们训练我们的系统去适应市场和变化。
subtitles.en: So we train our system to adapt to the market and to the changes.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:

subtitles.zh: 所以信贷需求非常疲软。这一次，你可以看到央行和中央政府投入了大量、更多的资源来支持经济。
subtitles.en: So in their face and very weak demand for credit. So this time around, you can see the central bank and central governments are putting a lot of, a lot more resources into supporting the economy.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为新的动能将来源于此。这是直接的国家推动。
subtitles.en: So I guess this is where the new momentum will come from. This is a direct state push.

subtitles.zh: 你知道，我认为今年早些时候的策略一直是，我要卖出中国、买入韩国。
subtitles.en: And you know, I think the strategy I think earlier this year was always, I'm going to sell China by Korea.

subtitles.zh: 你认为这个交易现在在某些方面正在逆转吗？
subtitles.en: Is that trade you think reversing now in some ways?

subtitles.zh: 嗯，我不想对抗AI，对吧？所以你之前谈到的所有故事、数字、报告，它们仍然相当强劲。
subtitles.en: Well, I don't want to battle against the AI, right? So in all the stories, the numbers, the reports that you just talked about earlier, they are still quite powerful.

subtitles.zh: 但除此之外，显然台湾、韩国的市场已经涨上天了。而中国确实，表现显著。
subtitles.en: But on top of that, obviously Taiwan, Korea, their stocks have gone through the roof. And China has really, and performed significantly.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，至少从战术角度来看，高歌猛进的台湾和韩国市场可能会暂停一下。
subtitles.en: So I think from, at least from a tactical point of view, the high-flying Taiwanese and the Korean market will likely take a pause.

subtitles.zh: 然后新兴市场中深度受压的部分，比如中国、巴西，未来会表现更好。
subtitles.en: And then the deeply depressed parts of EM, like China, Brazil, for example, they will do better going forward.

subtitles.zh: 所以这是一个小型轮动的故事。好的。
subtitles.en: So this is, there is a mini rotation story. Okay.

current_title_lines: 消费、医疗与资源板块谁领跑？

subtitles.zh: 那么在轮动方面，你在中国权益市场中关注和倾向哪些方向？
subtitles.en: So in terms of rotation, what are you looking and tilting towards to in the China equity market?

subtitles.zh: 如果你现在在第四季度增持，什么可能推动这个市场到年底？
subtitles.en: Then if you're going overweight now in the fourth quarter, what could potentially be driving this market into the end of the year?

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们之前看到的，尤其是今年第二季度，可能特别是在那之后，我们可以看到中国政府确实有意放缓了基础设施的资本支出，因为我们在第一季度有积极的惊喜。
subtitles.en: I think what we saw earlier, especially in the second quarter of this year, probably especially after the run-war, we can see the Chinese government really intentionally slowed down capital spending in infrastructure because we had positive

subtitles.zh: 然后可能北京担心，如果他们真的增加基础设施支出，会进一步推高企业的成本压力。
subtitles.en: And then probably Beijing was concerned that if they really increased spending in infrastructure, they would further push up cost pressure for companies.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为，在第四季度，我预计一些资本密集型板块会表现更好，尤其是它们来自如此低迷的起点。
subtitles.en: So I think like, so in Q4, I would expect some kind of capital intensive sectors to do better, especially they are coming from such a depressed starting point.

subtitles.zh: 但也有一些其他消费板块、医疗板块，几年前它们的估值倍数非常高。现在它们已经被完全洗出去了。
subtitles.en: But also some other consumer sectors, consumer sectors, healthcare sectors, they were treating at very high multiples a few years ago. Now they have been completely washed out.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为总体而言，我们预计市场将广泛上涨，但一些结构性故事，如消费板块、医疗板块可能表现良好。
subtitles.en: So I think broadly speaking, we would expect a broad rally in the stock market, but some structure stories like consumer sector, healthcare sector were likely to do well.

subtitles.zh: 还有一些资本密集型板块，材料、大宗商品相关板块也可能表现良好。
subtitles.en: And some very kept intensive sectors, material, commodity-related sectors were also probably to well.

subtitles.zh: 那么新兴市场金融板块的上涨潜力如何？
subtitles.en: What about the potential for upside for financials out of EMs?

briefs.speaker_context: Chief EM and China Strategist at Alpine Macro
briefs.current_title: Alpine Macro王岩：新兴市场金融板块迎来配置窗口？
current_title_lines: 货币政策周期带来顺风？

subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，这可能有点不同，但我们看到上周过去几个交易日，尤其是在香港市场，金融板块受到严重打击，因为一些关于收益率上升和金融状况的担忧。
subtitles.en: I mean, maybe a bit of a separate story, but we have been seeing the past couple of sessions last week, especially on the hung saying the finance stocks getting hard hit because of some of these elevated yield financial condition concerns.

subtitles.zh: 总体而言，如果我们谈论新兴市场金融板块，历史上新兴市场金融板块的相对表现与新兴市场的货币周期有非常紧密的相关性。
subtitles.en: Broadly speaking, if we talk about EM, EM financial, the relative performance of EM financials historically has had a very tight correlation with the monetary cycle in EM.

subtitles.zh: 所以这实际上相当讽刺，如果央行在边际上收紧，这对银行来说是好消息，因为这支持了它们的利润率，它们的净息差。
subtitles.en: So this is actually quite ironic if central banks are tightening that on margin, it's good news for banks because that supports their profit margin, their net interest margin.

subtitles.zh: 所以以企业借款人、企业家庭借款人为代价，实际上在紧缩周期中，金融板块往往表现更好。
subtitles.en: So at the expense of corporate borrowers, corporate household borrowers, so actually one in the tightening cycle, financials tend to do better.

subtitles.zh: 所以实际上在这一点上，我们认为增加对新兴市场金融板块的敞口是有道理的，因为现在边际上，新兴市场的银行正朝着紧缩周期移动。
subtitles.en: So at this point actually, we think it makes sense to increase exposure to EM financials because now on margin, EMs under banks are moving towards a tightening cycle.

subtitles.zh: 随着时间的推移，这可能为新兴市场金融板块带来某种顺风。
subtitles.en: And over time, this could lead to some kind of tailwind for EM financials.

subtitles.en: I'm just wondering what the rising global yields, Yang Wang, how you feel about it, right? I thought, when we thought 5% was where this could derail risk assets in the light.

subtitles.zh: 我们还没有完全看到这一点。我们是否需要在美国经济开始放缓时，认为中性利率会更高？
subtitles.en: We haven't quite seen that just yet. Do we need to subscribe a higher neutral rate on when the U.S. economy starts to slow down?

subtitles.zh: 你认为什么会支撑这一点？例如，是否需要美联储加息，或者你认为整个AI资本支出热潮的自然放缓会减缓事情？
subtitles.en: And what do you think is going to backstop that? Does it need a fed rate hike, for example, or do you think it's going to be a natural slowdown in this whole AI cap ex boom that's going to slow things down?

subtitles.zh: 我想它必须，你知道，市场必须见顶。它至少需要债券市场抛售来修正。
subtitles.en: I guess it has to, you know, the market has to peak out. It has the least correct for the bond market to sell off.

subtitles.zh: 但现在如果市场继续上涨，那么你知道，这意味着金融条件和利率还没有真正过度限制。
subtitles.en: But now if the stock market just keeps doing, keeps rising, then, you know, it means that the financial conditions interest rates are not really overly restrictive yet.

subtitles.zh: 那么债券收益率可能会继续上升。你知道，显然，从配置的角度来看，现在债券收益率处于这个水平，显然从配置角度来看变得更有吸引力。
subtitles.en: So then the bond yields will probably stay community to rise. You know, obviously, from from allocation point of view, now bond yields are at this level, obviously, it becomes a lot more attractive from allocation point of view.

subtitles.zh: 但我想，市场必须真正感受到收益率上升的压力，收益率才会回落。好的。
subtitles.en: But I guess it really, you know, stock market has to really feel the pressure from rising yield for yields to come off. All right.

briefs.speaker_context: CEO of MS Capital, a China-focused quantitative hedge fund
briefs.current_title: MS Capital张凯：内地市场波动中，量化策略如何捕捉超额收益？

subtitles.zh: 我们今年表现相当不错，年初至今大约22%。
subtitles.en: We are doing actually pretty good this year, the year-to-date is around 22%.

subtitles.zh: 因为我认为内地市场庞大、深厚且流动性充足。
subtitles.en: Because I think China market is enormous and also deep and liquid.

subtitles.zh: 所以差异创造了离散度，而离散度对我们这样的量化投资者来说创造了超额收益机会。
subtitles.en: So the difference is creates dispersion and dispersion for our like quantum investors creates opportunities of alpha.

subtitles.zh: 你们今年涨了多少？22%。
subtitles.en: You guys are up, how much this year? 22%.

subtitles.zh: 那市场中性策略呢？市场中性策略。为什么选择市场中性？
subtitles.en: So what about market neutral strategy? Market neutral strategy. Why market neutral?

subtitles.zh: 我认为内地市场是获取超额收益的好市场，而市场中性是为了对冲大部分市场方向。
subtitles.en: I see China is a very good market for alpha and the market neutral is to hedge most of the direction of the market.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们不需要预测方向。
subtitles.en: So we don't need to predict the direction.

subtitles.zh: 我们只需要稳定的离散度。
subtitles.en: We just have a steady dispersion.

subtitles.zh: 这相当了不起，因为据我们了解，在快速变动的市场中，你们的模型能够捕捉到一些变化。
subtitles.en: I mean, it's quite remarkable because as we understand it, fast-moving markets, your models have been able to pick up some of these shifts.

subtitles.zh: 你能详细介绍一下它们是如何构建来实现这一点的吗？是的。

subtitles.zh: 我认为我们有一个非常严谨的策略制定流程。

subtitles.zh: 我们首先处理数据，然后识别模式。
subtitles.en: We first, we process the data and then we identify the pattern.

subtitles.zh: 然后我们有严格的风险控制管理。
subtitles.en: Then we have a vigorous risk control management.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为整个过程也由AI增强。
subtitles.en: So I think the whole process is also enhanced by AI.

subtitles.zh: 现在我们甚至开发了自己的LLN来读取和解读这些信号，形成我们自己的模式。

subtitles.zh: 然后我们根据市场状态调整所有这些因子和策略。

subtitles.zh: AI在风险评估方面具体如何帮助？你谈到这些LLM。

briefs.speaker_context: CEO of MS Capital, a China-focused quantitative hedge fund
briefs.current_title: MS Capital张凯：超额收益不会消失，但懒人收益将退场

subtitles.zh: 它们正在开发中。是的。
subtitles.en: They're being developed. Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我认为AI确实让量化策略和量化交易更强大。
subtitles.en: I think AI does make quant strategies, quant trading is more powerful.

subtitles.zh: 因为AI本身不是超额收益，而是一种工具。
subtitles.en: As AI itself isn't an alpha, but it's a tool.

subtitles.zh: 取决于你如何使用它。
subtitles.en: It depends on how you use it.

subtitles.zh: 例如，我们早在2015年就将AI应用于我们的研究平台。
subtitles.en: For example, we, I think we applied AI to our research platform quite early back to 2015.

subtitles.zh: 如今我们确实看到了成果带来的好处。是的。
subtitles.en: And we do see the benefits from the result these days. Yeah.

subtitles.zh: 你怎么看，似乎有点矛盾，对吧？
subtitles.en: I mean, how do you look at the, there seems to be a bit of paradox, right?

subtitles.zh: 因为你看一些内地上市公司的分析师覆盖情况，
subtitles.en: Because you look at how what analyst coverage is on some of these A share listed companies,

subtitles.zh: 尤其是小盘股，我认为现在已经下降到略低于40%。
subtitles.en: particularly when it comes to small caps, I think that's dwindled to just under 40% here right now.

subtitles.zh: 但你看这些买卖价差，它们相当紧，比大多数新兴市场都要紧。
subtitles.en: But when you look at these bid-ass spreads, they're quite tight and quite tighter than most emerging markets out there here right now.

subtitles.zh: 你如何应对？在某种程度上，你认为这是看待量化交易和量化策略的矛盾吗？是的。
subtitles.en: How do you deal with that? And in some ways, do you think that it's a paradox in how you look at quant trading and quant strategies now? Yes.

subtitles.zh: 我认为现在人们总是问，随着市场变得拥挤，超额收益是否还存在，存在超额收益压缩。是的，仍然有超额收益，但懒惰的、容易的超额收益将退场。
subtitles.en: I think now people always ask, is there still alpha as it's getting crowded, there's alpha squeeze. Yes, there's still alpha, but the lazy alpha, the easy alpha is going to be retired.

subtitles.zh: 这取决于你在哪里寻找以及如何定义超额收益。
subtitles.en: And it depends on where you look for it and how you define the alpha.

subtitles.zh: 由于新政策、新环境，总会有新的超额收益。
subtitles.en: There's also always a new alpha because of the new policy, new environment.

subtitles.zh: 你不能依赖单一因子、单一策略、单一模型。
subtitles.en: And you cannot rely on one factor, one strategy, one model.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们训练我们的系统去适应市场和变化。
subtitles.en: So we train our system to adapt to the market and to the changes.
